arc_drowned_bell.title: The Drowned Bell
arc_drowned_bell.summary: A lost bell, a debt not written in money, and a village that would rather not remember either.

seeds.text: Garret's sister still takes the Ashen Hand's coin, somewhere upriver.

cmp_mudwallow.title: What the Water Keeps
cmp_mudwallow.premise: A scribe-turned-thief comes home to settle a ledger, and finds the village's oldest loss is not lost at all.
